title: Vibe synthesis: hierarchical agentic decision-making for intent-driven multistep molecule synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2611.18772v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The ability to construct complex molecules underpins advances in medicine and the molecular sciences. Yet long-horizon multistep synthesis requires decisions to be revised as evidence accumulates across chemically dependent operations, a capability not readily supported by artificial-intelligence tools and automated platforms organized around predefined tasks and hard-coded workflows. Here we propose and demonstrate a vibe synthesis system (VibeSyn), an intent-driven architecture in which hierarchical agents translate chemist-defined molecular objectives and accumulating evidence into adaptive decisions executed through computational tools and laboratory automation. We evaluate VibeSyn in three demonstrations of increasing scope and autonomy, progressing from evidence-grounded experimental decisions to adaptive execution of a ten-step total synthesis of catharanthine and structure-to-compound synthesis of cyclic peptides containing unn

translated_title: Vibe合成：面向意图驱动多步分子合成的分层智能体决策
translated_abstract: 构建复杂分子的能力是医学与分子科学进步的基石。然而，长时程多步合成要求决策随着证据在相互依赖的化学操作中不断积累而进行修正，而现有围绕预定义任务和硬编码工作流组织的人工智能工具与自动化平台难以支持这种能力。本文提出并演示了一种“vibe合成”系统，这是一种意图驱动的架构，其中分层智能体将化学家定义的分子目标以及不断积累的证据转化为自适应决策，并通过计算工具和实验室自动化加以执行。我们在三项范围与自主性逐步提升的演示中对VibeSyn进行了评估：从基于证据的实验决策，到长春花碱十步全合成的自适应执行，再到由结构直接合成含非天然结构单元的环肽化合物……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出意图驱动的分层智能体系统VibeSyn，能随实验证据的积累自适应调整合成决策，并结合计算工具与实验室自动化，成功完成了长春花碱的十步全合成及含非天然单元环肽的自主合成。
